title: Echo Ridge Investigation
quest_description: Word reached McBride of wolves massing along Echo Ridge — more than the season should bring, and bolder. The regard suspects they are circling the same pull you now carry. Go to the ridge and thin the pack; let the watcher see how you handle a hunt that hunts back.
objective_text: Slay Young Wolves at Echo Ridge.
offer_reward_text: The ridge is quieter. Whatever drew the pack has noticed you in turn.
request_items_text: The wolves still circle. Return when the ridge is thinned.
